**Authenticated proxy from seek clients to provider APIs.**

`seek serve` holds provider API keys and forwards seek client requests to the provider APIs. A client calls a provider through `/v1/proxy/{upstream}/{provider path}` with a client token. The server checks the token, replaces the client's credentials with the provider key, and forwards the request to the upstream's fixed base URL. The provider's response comes back unchanged: its status, status text, body and the `Content-Type`, `Cache-Control`, `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id` headers. The server buffers request bodies before forwarding and omits them for GET and HEAD. Response bodies stream, so Brave Answers server-sent events reach the client as they arrive.

The server forwards every method and every path under an upstream's prefix. The paths below are the routes seek's own commands call. Request and response bodies on those routes are the provider's formats.

Before forwarding, the server removes these request headers: `Authorization`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `Proxy-Authenticate`, `Cookie`, `Host`, `Connection` and the headers it nominates, `Keep-Alive`, `TE`, `Trailer`, `Transfer-Encoding`, `Upgrade`, `Content-Length`, `Accept-Encoding`, `Forwarded`, every `X-Forwarded-*` header, and every header any upstream uses for its key (`X-Api-Key`, `X-Subscription-Token`, `X-Goog-Api-Key`). All other request headers and the query string pass through.

Errors that seek itself returns are JSON objects with one `error` field. A provider's response passes through with its own status, which can be a status seek also uses. A path outside `/healthz` and `/v1/proxy/` returns 404 with `{"error":"not found"}` and needs no token. Under `/v1/proxy/`, the server checks the token before it reads the upstream, so a request without a valid token returns 401 for any upstream name. With a valid token, an upstream name the server does not know returns 404 with `{"error":"unknown provider '<name>'"}`. The server resolves `.` and `..` path segments, including percent-encoded ones, before routing.

Definition: [http-api.openapi.yml](http-api.openapi.yml) (OpenAPI 3.1.1, API version `1`).

## Servers

| URL | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8787` | The address `seek serve` binds by default. |

## Authentication

### clientToken

Type: `http`, scheme `bearer`.

A client token the server accepts, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The scheme name is case-insensitive. The server accepts each entry of its comma-separated `server.tokens`. A server whose `server.require-token` is false accepts requests without a token.

## health

Liveness of the server.

### `GET /healthz`

**Check that the server is running**

Returns 200 without authentication. The server answers this path for every method.

Operation ID: `getHealth`. Authentication: none.

Responses:

| Status | Description | Content type | Schema |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | The server is running. | `application/json` | [`Health`](#health-schema) |

Example `200` response (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

## parallel

Forwards to https://api.parallel.ai and adds the `x-api-key` header from `providers.parallel.api-key`.

### `POST /v1/proxy/parallel/v1/search`

**Parallel web search**

Called by `seek web parallel`.

Operation ID: `parallelSearch`. Authentication: [`clientToken`](#clienttoken).

Request body (optional): The provider's request body, forwarded unchanged.

| Content type | Schema |
| --- | --- |
| `application/json` | [`ProviderBody`](#providerbody-schema) |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Content type | Schema |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `401` | The client token is missing or the server does not accept it. See [`Unauthorized`](#unauthorized-response). | `application/json` | [`Error`](#error-schema) |
| `502` | The server could not reach the provider. See [`BadGateway`](#badgateway-response). | `application/json` | [`Error`](#error-schema) |
| `503` | The server has no API key for the upstream. See [`NoProviderKey`](#noproviderkey-response). | `application/json` | [`Error`](#error-schema) |
| `default` | The provider's response, passed through with its status and status text. Bodies stream; Brave Answers sends `text/event-stream`. See [`ProviderResponse`](#providerresponse-response). | `application/json` | [`ProviderBody`](#providerbody-schema) |
|  |  | `text/event-stream` | string |

## Components

### `Health` schema

Type: object.

| Field | Type | Accepted values | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | `"ok"` | Yes |  |

### `Error` schema

An error seek returns itself.

Type: object.

| Field | Type | Accepted values | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | string |  | Yes | What failed, naming the provider or variable involved. |

### `ProviderBody` schema

A body in the provider's own format, passed through unchanged.

Type: any.

### `Unauthorized` response

The client token is missing or the server does not accept it.

| Header | Type | Accepted values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `WWW-Authenticate` | string | `"Bearer"` | Always `Bearer`. |

| Content type | Schema |
| --- | --- |
| `application/json` | [`Error`](#error-schema) |

Example (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "error": "missing or invalid seek server token"
}
```

### `BadGateway` response

The server could not reach the provider.

| Content type | Schema |
| --- | --- |
| `application/json` | [`Error`](#error-schema) |

Example (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "error": "upstream request to exa failed"
}
```

### `NoProviderKey` response

The server has no API key for the upstream.

| Content type | Schema |
| --- | --- |
| `application/json` | [`Error`](#error-schema) |

Example (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "error": "seek server has no API key configured for exa (providers.exa.api-key)"
}
```

### `ProviderResponse` response

The provider's response, passed through with its status and status text. Bodies stream; Brave Answers sends `text/event-stream`.

| Header | Type | Accepted values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Cache-Control` | string |  | The provider's `Cache-Control` header, when it sent one. |
| `Retry-After` | string |  | The provider's `Retry-After` header, when it sent one. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string |  | The provider's `X-Request-Id` header, when it sent one. |

| Content type | Schema |
| --- | --- |
| `application/json` | [`ProviderBody`](#providerbody-schema) |
| `text/event-stream` | string |
